subject: mathematics
title: Add-Up Adventure · Q2 W04 D04
objective: Add numbers with sums up to 10,000, with or without regrouping.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Add from ones to thousands. Regroup 10 ones as 1 ten, 10 tens as 1 hundred, and so on. Ready to explore?

vocabulary.definition: a number that is added to another number
to trade 10 ones for 1 ten (or 10 tens for 1 hundred)

activities.instruction: Listen to Milo. He will show you how to add from ones to thousands.
activities.content: Add from ones to thousands. three hundred six plus four hundred eighty nine equals seven hundred ninety five. Regroup 10 ones as 1 ten when needed.

feedback.correct: Great thinking! You found the key idea. 🎉

items.explanation: The answer is “795.” It uses what we learned about number skills.

items.prompt: Which number sentence is correct for three hundred six plus four hundred eighty nine?
items.explanation: The answer is “306 + 489 = 795.” It uses what we learned about number skills.

items.prompt: When you add three hundred six and four hundred eighty nine, which place do you add first?
items.explanation: The answer is “ones.” It uses what we learned about number skills.

items.prompt: Which is a good estimate for three hundred six plus four hundred eighty nine?
